Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax)

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) is the coach for the formal pickup: twenty-nine of the most comfortable, plush leather seats on the fleet, every one of them reclining, on a wood floor, in a grey coach that reads executive from the curb. Room for thirty bags.

About the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax)

Classic blue ambient lighting, a built-in cooler, a custom sound system with subwoofers, tinted windows and climate control.

The one we send for weddings, golf groups, executive outings, and any day that needs a formal pickup and drop-off with the luggage along for the ride.

Seats: Plush leather seats, every one of them reclining

Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $225 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $550. Seats 29, room for 30 bags.
